name: Duskline Reapers
description: One of the oldest continuously operating underground fighting stables on the Shelf, the Duskline Reapers have been running fighters through the BLOODWORK circuit and its predecessor circuits since the city's early consolidation years. Based out of a sub-basement network beneath the Duskline transit interchange, the stable is managed by the extended Ferreira-Molotov family, who treat fighter development as a generational craft — current stable director Kazimiera Ferreira-Molotov is the third generation to hold the role. The Reapers field both augmented and bare fighters depending on the circuit, and are known for producing technically disciplined competitors rather than spectacle brawlers.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 investigative journalist goes undercover as a corner-person for the Reapers and uncovers a chrome-supply chain connected to an illegal augmentation trial.
A Reapers fighter is offered a legitimate path into a Tier 2 augmented league but must first fulfill a contract obligation that requires throwing a critical underground bout.

The Ferreira-Molotov family's stable records, stretching back to 2183, contain the only surviving documentation of a Shelf district that was quietly demolished by HelixCorp — and someone very powerful wants those records destroyed.
